title: PM-KUSUM Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan
summary: Schemes — PM-KUSUM Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan

items: Mahabhiyan):
Launched on 8th March 2019 by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy with the objective of
providing farmers with solar-powered irrigation pumps and promoting the use of barren land for solar
energy generation.
Key Features:
o Component A: Installation of 10,000 MW decentralized solar plants on barren land.
o Component B: Installation of 14 lakh solar-powered agriculture pumps.
o Component C: Solarization of 35 lakh grid-connected agricultural pumps.
Benefits:
o Reduces dependency on grid power.
o Generates additional income from solar power sales.
o Promotes renewable energy and rural development.
Subsidy Structure:
o Up to 60% subsidy (30% central, 30% state, 30% loan from banks).
o Farmers contribute 10% of the total cost.
Eligibility:
o Farmers with agricultural land for solar pump installation.
Timeline:
o Launch Date: 8th March 2019
o End Date: 31st March 2026
